pr_title: Switch LSP prompts to use a non-blocking toast
pr_body: This fixes a major degradation in usability that some users ran into. Fixes https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/8255 Fixes https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/8229 Release Notes: - Switch from using platform prompts to toasts for LSP prompts. ([8255](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/8255), [8229](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/8229))

comments: This is also happening to me in a TypeScript project also. Mine is a monorepo FWIW
@bogdan-velicu looking into my error more it is a little different but I did fix it by changing something in my eslint config, can you post your eslint config here?

After the latest update this popup keeps appearing after I open the project, open or save a file, or even type a character. The editor is practically unusable. Zed Preview 0.124.1 Edit: looks like the package is not installed, thus the error, but I guess it should not be shown like this that prevents me from using the editor.

Can you please provide a project to reproduce this on?
Simple projects like https://github.com/koddsson/eslint-configs-demo do not seem to trigger that, unfortunately.

The code I was working on is proprietary to the company I work for and I'm afraid I'm not able to share that, I have yet to see this behaviour in any of my other projects. I will share anything that seems relevant to this issue when I stumble upon it.

@SomeoneToIgnore I can try to setup an app that has an eslint error like this, but I think you are exactly right, the error needs to be less intrusive. I will update here when I have a project that reproduces this.

@SomeoneToIgnore I created a repo where you should get an ESLint error. Like I said this error is valid however because of an error you can not do anything which is pretty annoying. Please let me know if you have any questions!

https://github.com/jordanjones98/eslint-error-test

Thanks to @mikayla-maki we did get rid of the blocking part of those notifications and this should be better now.
Unfortunately, that project did not work for them during issue reproduction, so it's still not very clear how many of those pop-ups will appear and now irritating they will be, even not being blocking.

Zed Preview 0.124.5 was released with this fix, please provide more feedback if something is not working well here.

@SomeoneToIgnore I will load it up once I get the release pulled down to see if it is better or not. Judging by the PR it looks like it will be but I will test it.

@mikayla-maki thank you for the quick turn around! Very much appricated.

@SomeoneToIgnore Just to follow up here that issue is fixed in my ESLint

@kspadhi the issue seems to have been resolved with the latest update that went out yesterday! The error is still there, because it is an error, but it is in a non invasive dialog.
